info.title: Food Standards Agency — Food Hygiene Ratings
info.description: Every inspected food business in England, Wales and NI with its official hygiene rating (0-5; Scotland uses Pass/Improvement Required). Keyless; requires the x-api-version header, which this realm pins.

get.summary: Inspected food businesses near a coordinate pair, nearest first
get.description: `establishments[]` carries `BusinessName`, `BusinessType`, `RatingValue` ('0'-'5', or 'AwaitingInspection'/'Exempt' — not numbers, guard before toFloat), `RatingDate`, `Distance` (miles) and `FHRSID`. `meta.totalCount` counts every business the filter matches, across all pages.

parameters.name: ratingKey
parameters.description: Only businesses with this rating: '0'-'5', 'AwaitingInspection' or 'Exempt' — the RatingValue strings themselves. An unrecognised value is ignored, not rejected.

parameters.name: sortOptionKey
parameters.description: Result order. 'Distance' is nearest first; WITHOUT it the service orders by rating, best first, so a capped page holds the best-rated businesses in the radius rather than the nearest. Others: 'rating', 'desc_rating' (lowest first), 'alpha', 'desc_alpha', 'Relevance'.
